'''Skipchaser''' was an [[X-wing simulator]] used during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]. The simulation was used to teach [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] about their [[Yuuzhan Vong empire|new enemy's]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] equivalent, [[Yorik-et|coralskippers]].

Skipchaser started with the pilot in their [[T-65A3 X-wing starfighter|X-wing]], with nothing on the [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]]. The simulation would then give the pilot a target, a small [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]]. The "asteroid" would gain speed, and use its [[dovin basal]] to strip the X-wing of its [[Deflector shield/Legends|shields]]. The dovin basal would also absorb any laser fire into a black hole, and would end the simulation by destroying the X-wing with plasma fired from its [[Yaret-Kor]].

Even experienced pilots had a difficult time lasting in the simulation. [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Gavin Darklighter]] lasted only twenty five [[Standard second|seconds]] on his first attempt. [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Traest Kre'fey]] considered this an accomplishment; he had only lasted fifteen seconds.
